While some mambas have slight edging, this level of perfect reticulation is suspicious and likely an AI artifact or misclassification of species (e.g., vine snake).
The transition from the neck to the head is slightly abrupt and lacks the subtle muscular definition expected in a high-resolution photograph, appearing somewhat 'molded'.
